title: Sonder golden eval case (EXPERIMENTAL)
description: Proposed shape for one pinned regression-eval case, borrowing the task/solver/scorer decomposition popularized by Inspect AI and the assertion style of Promptfoo, adapted to Sonder's grounded-outcome discipline: every scorer must be a deterministic host-side check (compile, test, schema, exact/contains match) or an explicitly-labeled model grader that can never be the sole gate for promotion. This file is a research artifact under docs/research/ and is NOT read by the runtime.

case_id.description: Stable id; renaming a case is a history break and should be treated like deleting one.

task.description: Which Sonder lane the case exercises: e.g. codegen_build_loop, retrieval, solver, chat, fleet_task.

input.description: Everything needed to replay the case deterministically.

fixture_paths.description: Workspace-relative fixture files; each should be committed or referenced by hash.

fixture_sha256.description: Pin of each fixture's bytes so a drifted fixture fails loudly instead of silently changing the case.

tier.description: Model tier alias the case targets (fast/code/general); omitted means the router decides.

scorers.description: All scorers must pass for the case to pass. Deterministic scorers are the promotion authority; model_grader results are advisory diagnostics only.

value.description: Scorer payload: expected string, regex, schema path, test command, or expected tool-name sequence.

advisory.description: MUST be true when kind is model_grader; advisory scorers report but never gate.

source.description: Where the case came from: a real grounded outcome id, a regression (link the fix), or an authored probe.
